question: A solid sphere of iron having radius 15 cm is to be melted and recast in the shape of a cylindrical pipe having internal and external radii 4 cm and 6 cm, respectively. Find the length (in m) of the pipe thus formed.

Radius of solid sphere (r) = 15 cm
